notes: Added Outfit Collection automation for scanning collection progress, acquiring eligible missing outfits, upgrading outfits, and submitting completed +2 outfits.
Added Auto Sell automation for configurable and automated Inventory cleanup.
Improved automation recovery and state handling across supported game activities.
Improved login, server availability, world map navigation, and UI interaction handling.
Improved reward handling by stopping earlier when matched priority rewards are detected.
Fixed Tailed Beast automation so defeated or removed beasts can be skipped and the automation can continue to the next valid target.
Fixed recovery cases that could leave automations stuck or cause repeated interactions after game or connection state changes.

sections.title: New Features
items: Outfit Collection — Scan Collection progress, review a completion plan, acquire eligible missing outfits from selectable pots, upgrade outfits to +2, and submit completed outfits to Collection.
Auto Sell — Scan Inventory, search and group eligible items, configure keep counts, review the sell plan, and automatically process eligible item stacks.

sections.title: Improvements
items: Improved automation recovery and state handling across supported game activities.
Improved server availability and login-screen handling during automation recovery.
Improved world map navigation and destination detection.
Improved UI interaction handling to reduce rapid or repeated actions during navigation.
Improved reward handling by stopping earlier when matched priority rewards are detected.
Improved slow-server handling across Collection navigation, Inventory transitions, pot selection, and synthesis.
Reduced unnecessary repeated Inventory and Collection scans by reusing verified scan results during execution.
Improved Outfit Collection with Low Purify Stone support, exact outfit variant matching, category-aware Collection routing, and synthesis retry recovery.
Improved Auto Sell with bound/unbound grouping, keep-count controls, split handling, and stack-aware execution.
Refined sidebar organization and icons for Inventory workflows and Clan.
Improved overall reliability during delayed or interrupted game interactions.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Fixed Tailed Beast automation so defeated or removed beasts are skipped correctly and automation can continue to the next valid target.
Fixed recovery cases where automation could remain stuck after game or connection state changes.
Fixed cases where repeated UI interactions could occur while navigation or another action was still in progress.
